results.statement: Zero- and nonzero-syndrome cycles cannot be the same exact transition isomorph when the compared anatomy preserves ordered delta composition, because syndrome is invariant under that comparison.
Equality of the eight coarse local/topological cycle summaries is not sufficient for TI: an exact matched signature contains both a zero and nonzero cycle.
Nonlocal transport-only recursive equivalence occurs in flat 4x5 as well as obstructed 5x4; it is not a sufficient transition-anatomy signature for frustration.

Tested cases support a useful decomposition into cycle opportunity (reachability/topology) and cocycle frustration (ordered sheet-delta composition). The former can vary under transpose without the latter becoming nonzero.

Within the line-family intervention, H+D transition/residual interaction is enough to create frustrated cycles in 5x4 k=4 but not 4x5; the unresolved differentiator therefore lies below line-family presence alone.

ti_nonclaims: No universal cycle mechanism is claimed.
The k=4 rank+action-word classifier is not promoted to a TI invariant across k because holdout support is incomplete.
